Sir Henry, Good, and Umbopa ranged themselves alongside of me, and lifted their rifles. “Stop!” I shouted boldly, though at the moment my heart was in my boots. we, the white men from the Stars, say that it shall not be. Come but one pace nearer, and we will put out the moon like a wind-blown lamp, as we who dwell in her House can do, and plunge the land in darkness.
